votes.motion: Commissioner Everett moved to approve the Consent Agenda with the minutes         from the Planning Commission meetings from the May 4, 2023 meeting, July 27, 2023         meeting, August 24, 2023 meeting, September 7, 2023 meeting, September 14, 2023         meeting, October 5, 2023 meeting, October 12, 2023 meeting, October 26, 2023 meeting,         and the November 2, 2023 meeting. Commissioner Jackson seconded.

Public hearing and consideration of Joe Moschetti’s request for conditional use approval of Freedom Trucking Driving School with Vehicle Storage located at approximately 4300 North Digital Drive. Jacob Curtis presented information on the agenda item.

Public hearing and recommendation of Daron Johnson's request for review of the Larson Zone Change for two parcels totaling 3.6 acres located at approximately 1700 North Boston Street changing from Transitional Holding to Light Industrial. Jacob Curtis presented information on the agenda item.

Consideration of Morgan Michaelis’ request for approval of Grandview Estates Plat A, a 2-lot subdivision with an existing home located at 214 South 300 East. Jacob Curtis presented information on the item.
Consideration of Tayler Sant's request for approval of Willes Plat B, a 2-lot subdivision with an existing home located at 350 East 300 South. Jacob Curtis presented information on the item.
Consideration of Hawthorn Homes request for approval of the Barber 2-lot subdivision with an existing home located at 1454 West 900 North. Jacob Curtis presented information on the agenda item.

Public hearing and consideration of Howland Partners request for conditional use approval of Kura Sushi and Flower Child site plan with a drive-thru located at 2001 West Ridge Road. Jacob Curtis presented information on the item.

Public hearing and consideration of Jeff Southard’s request for conditional use approval of the Bellaview Commercial site plan with drive-thru's located at 1200 West 3600 North. Jacob Curtis presented information on the agenda item.

Public hearing and recommendation of Parker Johnson’s request for review of the Beacon Point zone change, 0.80 acres located at 1054 West Main Street changing the zoning from Commercial to Mixed-Use. Jacob Curtis presented information on the item.

Public hearing and recommendation of Parker Johnson’s request for review of the Beacon Point Concept, a 17-unit mixed-use residential development located at 1054 West Main Street. Jacob Curtis presented information on the item.

Public hearing and recommendation of Britani Bateman’s request for review of the Marwood Group Concept, a 31-unit residential development on 0.84 acres located at 301 East State Street. Jacob Curtis presented information on the agenda item.

Public hearing and recommendation of Lehi City’s request for review of a Development Code Amendment to Table 37.080, Off-Street Parking requirements, removing a proximity requirement for townhomes adjacent to on-street parking. Jacob Curtis presented information on the item.
